title: Totemicy : Mysticism
description:
a set of unique magical items to aid with your journey
a spiritual successor to Totemicy
body:
**Made for Hackcraft:**
https://hackcraft.hackclub.com/

![hackcraft banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/31f47ff2022f96e548d1c4aaa2e48112a9712a3b.png)
Totemicy : Mysticism is a seqeul to [Totemicy](https://modrinth.com/mod/totemicy) that features some slightly more unique and higher quality items that should aid with combat and adventure.
For example, you can craft an orb that summons thunder on all entities in a small range on right click, an orb that lets you dash on right click, or a bat with high knockback that sends enemies flying upwards.
All recipes require the ruby, a new item crafted as an upgrade to diamonds to offer a decent midtier experience.

Recipes in gallery.
